sources.trainerCostSource: seen in Forever by players' ForeverDB addon: the full price, with the reputation discount the game showed taken off
sources.note: Prices are in copper: price buys one purchase of stack items (pricePerItem: one item's share); costs are what the vendor asks besides gold (Merchant's Favor and other currencies, or items), as players' addons saw them. Vendors and trainers are Classic data (CMaNGOS) unless seenInForever; notOnListPlayersSaw: Classic's limited-supply line that wasn't on the list players saw at that vendor (the game leaves sold-out items off). A trainer that players saw teach the recipe in Forever is listed even when Classic has no record of it, and trainerCostSource says whether the price is what players saw (the full price: the game shows each player a reputation discount, which is taken off) or Classic's. Trainers marked inferred weren't seen with this recipe, but a trainer with the same title was (Forever's trainers with one title teach one list). drops is every drop (dropsInAll). Quests and drops come from players' ForeverDB addon where seen, else Classic data.
